label: NIWA documents the CLUES Stage II pilot and model inputs
summary: The July 2006 Stage II report documented an ArcGIS 8.3/9 scenario toolbox, Environment Waikato pilot testing, integrated SPARROW, OVERSEER and Harris Consulting outputs, partner-only file exchange and data limitations that left SPASMO non-spatial.
